entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element used to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events from the network to the UE.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network entity that includes the PCO IE in messages when it wishes to transmit protocol data to the UE.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE that receives protocol data via the PCO IE when extended protocol configuration options are not supported.

entities.name: Extended PCO not supported
entities.description: Condition where extended protocol configuration options are not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

relations.description: Network includes the PCO IE in messages when it wishes to transmit protocol data to the UE.
PCO IE is included when extended protocol configuration options are not supported by the UE or network.
PCO IE enables transmission of protocol data from network to UE.
